caption: A close, top-down view fills the frame with a white ceramic bowl whose interior base bears a blue painted floral motif. A shallow pool of clear liquid coats the bottom, and a single translucent, glossy oval object rests in the center, partly submerged against the pattern. A bright specular highlight sits on the upper-left surface of the oval, while a dark shadowed area fills the left inner wall of the bowl. A reddish-brown surface is visible at the lower-left edge outside the rim. Throughout the excerpt, the oval, the liquid line, the blue pattern, and the bowl rim maintain their positions.
